answer: Witnessed Ridge Binding. Each identity must continuously publish a signed sensor trace from a unique hardware element whose secret is fused at manufacture and never exportable. Peers co-sign only traces whose physical fingerprints (thermal drift, copper trace noise, clock jitter) match the enrolled device. A single operator cannot fake many devices because cloning costs a full fabrication run per identity. The operative cost is one physical unit plus its calibration sonnet of lab hours, making mass sybils economically irrational.
